DigiFT native fund mandate and shareholder rights (January 24, 2025)

reserveReview.rationale: The 100% slice describes the authenticated native Singapore VCC fund-share claim, not measured portfolio weights. DigiFT's January 24, 2025 native-fund disclosure names UBS (Irl) Select Money Market Fund - USD as the all-or-substantially-all underlying investment, investing in short-term USD debt of US and non-US governmental and other issuers. The exact underlying share class and current allocation remain unavailable. The March 2025 dossier names State Street as native custodian/administrator and EY as auditor. Its Plan design section 10 correctly attributes Aaa-mf to Moody's and AAAmmf to Fitch, unlike its reversed introductory ratings and the prior review. These remain historical distributor assertions, not a current agency opinion or financial-assurance report. The private native PPM, current look-through positions and token-to-fund reconciliation are unavailable.

DigiFT native fund custody trust and VCC statutory segregation (January 24, 2025)

custodyProfile.uncertainty: DigiFT's January 2025 native-fund disclosure, separate from its DR proposal, states that native fund assets are held in trust at the fund custodian, with separate fund/class accounts and statutory sub-fund liability segregation under VCC Act section 29. It expressly warns that non-Singapore courts may not apply that bankruptcy remoteness. Segregated/structured describe this disclosed native legal structure, not a current independent custody audit or a guarantee of recovery. The March 2025 dossier names State Street; exact underlying share class, current allocations, complete material custody layers, rehypothecation terms and native PPM remain unavailable. The whole-book custodyModel remains unknown. DR-wrapper bare-trust claims are not imported.
